info.title: LunaNX
info.author: PostTenebrasSoftware
info.description: Unofficial Amazon Luna client for Switch
info.details: Unofficial native Amazon Luna client for Nintendo Switch homebrew. Sign in with Amazon's device code, select a profile, browse your games and stream with NVDEC hardware video, sound and controller input. Includes remembered sign-in, search, game pages, screenshots/trailers, Recently Played, bitrate/video settings and a live statistics overlay. Return Home, reconnect or explicitly end a game; switching games asks first. Requires full application memory/title takeover, internet and your own eligible Luna account/game access. No PC companion, games or subscription are included. Handheld 720p60 is hardware-tested; docked 1080p is untested. Not affiliated with Amazon or Nintendo. Original code is GPL-3.0-or-later; matching source and dependency notices accompany the release.\n\nAI use: Mostly AI-generated. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.
